control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: residual pressure found after isolation of CV-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on CV-3100 and M-3100 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. CV-3100 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 25 May 2006 a near hit was recorded on CV-3100 and M-3100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
